core_obligations: Even with standard convexity of length functions, Wolpert twist formulas, Thurston Lipschitz maps and topological Morse theory supplied, the full-increase-cone result does not follow from smooth Morse theory or linear independence. The author must select filling subsets through supporting hyperplanes, pass from the first-order Voronoi decomposition to actual systole strata under small length deformations, treat rank-increasing gradient spans with the cropped-span cross section, and close the minimum case by relative-stratum limits. The balanced top-dimensional stratum result then uses the filling-face construction and excludes a larger adjacent stratum. This complete nonsmooth geometric passage is retained as one H2 framework, distinct from existing559 localcritical-cell conclusion; support lemmas and vector-field application are not separate counts. Author arguments and subdivision footnote preserved without mathematical recertification.
